claims.statement: UK Gambling Commission guidance requires remote licensees to monitor multiple harm-indicator categories, act in a timely way, keep meaningful interaction records, and evaluate intervention impact.

contrary_evidence: Operators remain responsible when using third parties and large platforms may already include responsible-gambling tooling.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: with explicit rights, de-identified intervention-outcome evidence improves thresholds and demonstrates what reduces harm
fingerprint.customer: licensed remote gambling operators needing auditable customer-interaction controls
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: responsible-gambling consultants, platform integrators, and independent control auditors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: streaming risk API, explainable flags, intervention workflow, manual-review queue, and audit log
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the licensed operator pays on production integration and monthly monitored-account processing
fingerprint.problem_trigger: account behavior crosses a harm indicator or an interaction requires follow-up and outcome evaluation

founder_fit: Excellent behavioral-data and neuroscience adjacency with a socially protective purpose; enterprise sales and on-call reliability should be delegated.
risks: False negatives can harm customers and create regulatory exposure.
The founder's personal interest in gambling must not distort a safety-first product.

structure.control_point: the risk flag, recorded action, and follow-up evidence generated before a customer-interaction compliance review
structure.critical_dependency: operator event-stream access, regulator-aligned controls, and lawful use of intervention outcomes across clients

thesis: Provide licensed remote gambling operators with real-time harm indicators, explainable intervention triggers, case records, and outcome evaluation. The moat is a permissioned intervention-outcome benchmark, not a system that optimizes gambling engagement. All commercial numbers, including capital_required_pln, are unvalidated hypotheses.
title: Safer-Gambling Intervention Evidence API
uncertainties: Availability of intervention labels and cross-operator rights is unknown.
Sales cycles to regulated operators may exceed part-time capacity.
